description: Language-neutral vectors of the beyond-host rule: a unit is beyond a machine when its largest known peak (the carving entry's measured peak for its crate and target, or the peak learned on the machine) is above the final budget of the worker class and the machine is no larger than the class host. A unit never measured, and a machine larger than the class, answer false.
